title: 第3210章 鸿蒙掌控第3210章 鸿蒙掌控
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: “这山脉，终于算是走到头了。”
“这天宫还真是够大的。”
“就是这山脉的尽头，看起来有点诡异啊。”
后面的路，并没有遇到太多的危险，虽然也遇到了一些生物，但对陈长安他们都构不成威胁。
终于来到了山脉的尽头，但山脉的尽头，是一个巨大的峭壁，峭壁很高，也很长，拦住了所有的去路。
在这峭壁中间，则是有一个看起来像是能量入口的地方。
“难道说，这天宫内部，是由不同地域所构成的，每一个地域之间，都有这么一个链接的入口？”
“很有这种可能。”
“如果我没有猜错的话，当年的事情发生之后，神殊一族也担心还会再有同样的事情发生。”
“所以，将所有区域都切割开，只留下来了一个链接的入口。”
“这样一来，平时这些区域的存在，就没有办法暗中联合起来。”
“所以，这入口，应该也不是可以随便进出的。”
“不信的话，你们可以去试试。”
听到陈长安的话，火耀第一个走了过去，果然没有办法进入那个入口。
“还真进不去。”
“那咱们怎么办？就这么回去吗？”
“不过回去也好，咱们这一趟虽然弄到的资源并不是很多，但好过于无。”
“这里既然进不去，咱们这一路又没有遇到其他的族人，我想，那些族人先辈，应该是已经不在了。”火耀无奈的说道。
“你们进不去，不意味着我也进不去。”
“你们留在这里等着，我自己一个人进去看看。”
“你自己去？”
“行吧，反正你也死不了，不过要是真的有大麻烦，还是赶紧回来的好。”
原本火耀还想要劝劝，可想到陈长安的妖孽之处，又改了口风。
“我们在这里等你，不管多久。”
牧云谣是了解陈长安的，这里他们都进不去，只有陈长安一个人不受到任何的限制。
可陈长安又是一个不会轻易放弃的人，他自己进去之后，没有了这群拖累，恐怕会走的更远。
“放心，应该不会太久的。”
“把你们都留在这里，我也不是很放心。”
“我进去看看就回来。”
听到陈长安的话，牧云谣也有些意外，这人是转性了？竟然真的只是进去看看就回来？
content_en:
"This mountain range has finally come to an end."
"This Heavenly Palace is really big enough."
"It's the end of this mountain range. It looks a bit weird."
There were not many dangers along the way. Although they encountered some creatures, they did not pose a threat to Chen Changan and the others.
Finally we came to the end of the mountain range, but at the end of the mountain range was a huge cliff. The cliff was very high and long, blocking all the way.
In the middle of the cliff, there is a place that looks like an energy entrance.
"Could it be said that the interior of this heavenly palace is composed of different regions, and there is such a connecting entrance between each region?"
"It's very possible."
"If I'm not wrong, after what happened that year, the Shenshu clan was also worried that the same thing would happen again."
"So, all the areas were cut away, leaving only a link entrance."
"In this way, there is no way for those in these areas to unite secretly."
"So, this entrance shouldn't be accessible by anyone."
"If you don't believe it, you can try it."
After hearing Chen Changan's words, Huo Yao was the first to walk over, but as expected there was no way to enter the entrance.
"I really can't get in."
"Then what should we do? Just go back like this?"
"But it's okay to go back. Although we didn't get a lot of resources on this trip, it's better than nothing."
"Since we can't get in here and we didn't meet any other clansmen along the way, I think those clan ancestors are probably gone." Huo Yao said helplessly.
"Just because you can't get in, doesn't mean I can't get in either."
"You guys stay here and wait, I'll go in and take a look by myself."
"Are you going by yourself?"
"This..."
"Okay, you won't die anyway, but if there is really big trouble, it's better to come back quickly."
Originally Huo Yao wanted to persuade him, but he changed his tune when he thought of Chen Changan's evil side.
"We'll wait for you here, no matter how long it takes."
Mu Yunyao knew Chen Changan, and none of them could enter here. Only Chen Changan was not subject to any restrictions.
But Chen Changan is a person who will not give up easily. After he enters, he will probably go further without this group of people dragging him down.
"Don't worry, it shouldn't take long."
"I'm not very relieved to leave you all here."
"I'll go in and take a look and come back."
Hearing Chen Changan's words, Mu Yunyao was also a little surprised. Has this person changed his gender? Did you really just go in and have a look and then come back?
